connectors.intro: Connect literature, data, code and personal knowledge to your research tasks.

custom.urlPlaceholder: Enter the MCP server URL, e.g. https://example.com/mcp
custom.commandPlaceholder: Enter a command or executable path
custom.hint: Saving checks the real connection. Supports HTTP, SSE and STDIO. Verify the source first; STDIO executes local commands. Services declaring OAuth use the authorization flow.
custom.timeoutHint: Leave blank for the default; otherwise enter an integer ≥1000. Suggested: 30000 (30 seconds).
custom.timeoutError: Enter an integer of at least 1000 milliseconds; for 30 seconds, enter 30000.
custom.targetChanged: The service target or launch configuration changed. Enter credentials again; original credentials are never forwarded to a new target.
custom.batch: Continue editing multiple connectors in JSON mode; they cannot be converted to a single form.
custom.jsonHint: Import multiple entries using mcpServers. Supports type, url, headers, command, args, cwd and env. Unsupported fields are rejected, never silently ignored.
custom.name: Connector name
custom.argsHint: For example ["-y", "package"]. Arguments, spaces and empty strings are preserved without shell interpolation.
custom.retain: Existing values are never returned. Keep a field blank to retain its original value, or remove the field to delete it.
custom.hidden: Header and environment values are hidden and kept only in private local backend storage.
custom.activeEdit: This connector is enabled. Saving applies the new configuration, but does not by itself mark the connection as ready.
custom.invalid: Invalid configuration. Check the name, URL, argument array and fields. Put credentials in headers, not the URL.
custom.unsupported: Unsupported transport. Use HTTP, SSE or STDIO.
custom.duplicate: A connector with this name already exists. Choose another name.
custom.conflict: The configuration changed elsewhere. Refresh and edit again to avoid overwriting changes.
custom.failed: Could not save the configuration. Check the runtime and retry. Your input has been retained.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.authorizationComplete: Authorization completed, but connection failed. Credentials are retained; retry the connection.
connectors.credentialsSaved: Credentials saved, but connection failed. Authorization validity has not been confirmed. Credentials are retained; retry when the service is available.
connectors.renewalHint: When the service provides refresh credentials, tokens renew automatically without repeated authorization. Reauthorize if renewal is no longer available.
connectors.enableAfterAuthorization: Authorize this connector before enabling it
connectors.toolsPending: Tools have not been fetched. Retry the connection.
connectors.toolsFailed: Could not read tools. Check the connection error and retry.
connectors.authDescription: Credentials stay in private backend storage on this device and are not returned to the frontend.
connectors.gitlabRequirement: Use a fine-grained GitLab.com API Key with MCP tool Execute permission and MCP access enabled by the top-level group.
connectors.notionRequirement: Get an API Key for MCP from the link above; ordinary integration credentials are not supported. Only Business/Enterprise workspace owners can create one.
connectors.zoteroRequirement: Your API Key needs personal library read access. Your account is detected automatically. Group libraries also require read access; ask in the conversation to discover and switch libraries.
connectors.oauthDescription: The provider's authorization page opens in your system browser. Sign-in, workspace selection and consent are handled by the provider.
connectors.revokeDescription: Keep the installation and remove local credentials. Remote authorization is revoked when supported; otherwise manage it on the provider's website.
connectors.removeDescription: Remove the local installation, configuration and credentials. Third-party content is not deleted.

errors.storage: Connector configuration is temporarily unavailable. Refresh and try again later.
errors.service: The connector service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.method: This authorization or operation method is not supported. Refresh the connector and retry.
errors.notInstalled: Add this connector before performing this operation.
errors.unknown: This connector no longer exists. Refresh the list and retry.
errors.commandMissing: Startup command not found. Edit the configuration and check where the program is installed.
errors.dependencyMissing: The local program is missing dependencies. Follow the MCP service's installation instructions.
errors.processFailed: Local MCP startup or handshake failed. Check the command, arguments, working directory and dependencies.
errors.protocolFailed: MCP handshake or protocol communication failed. Check the service URL, transport and server response.
errors.protocolUnsupported: The service returned an unsupported MCP protocol version. Check server and client version compatibility.
errors.replacement: New authorization did not pass connection verification. Original authorization is retained. Check and retry.
errors.authorizationUrl: The service did not return a valid HTTPS authorization URL. Check the service configuration and retry.
errors.localRuntime: Local MCP tools have not been verified. Check the command and dependencies, then read tools from a real session. Zotero requires an installed zotero-mcp.
errors.credentials: The service requires authentication. Credentials are missing, invalid or expired. Check authentication settings or authorize again.
errors.permission: The service or network gateway returned 403 and denied access. Check account permissions, organization policies or network restrictions; this alone does not prove the API Key is invalid.
errors.quota: Service quota or rate limit reached. Try again later.
errors.network: Cannot connect to the service. Check the network, proxy and service availability; this alone does not prove the credentials are invalid.
errors.timeout: Connecting to or reading from the service timed out. Check the network and service status, then retry.
errors.networkBlocked: The response contains a network security policy notice blocking the domain. Check domain access through your security process instead of repeatedly replacing the API Key.
errors.responseInvalid: The service response could not be decoded or does not match the connection protocol. This does not establish that your credentials are invalid. Retry; if it persists, check the server or gateway response.
errors.tls: The TLS handshake failed or the secure connection was interrupted before a valid service response was received. Check the proxy, security gateway and server connection; this is not a credential validation failure.
errors.certificate: TLS certificate verification failed. Check the system clock, trusted certificates and enterprise proxy certificate configuration. Do not disable certificate verification.
errors.proxy: Proxy connection or authentication failed. Check proxy availability and authentication settings; this is not a connector account authorization failure.
errors.registration: This service requires a preregistered OAuth client. Configure the provider application for ScholarSeed and retry.
errors.loginRequired: Sign in to ScholarSeed before connecting this platform. If already signed in, check whether your session has expired.
errors.library: Cannot access the Zotero library. Check the account and library permissions associated with your API Key.
errors.cancelled: Authorization was not completed. You can retry.
errors.expired: Authorization timed out. Cancel and start again.
errors.configuration: Authorization or installation was saved, but runtime configuration failed. Refresh and retry.
errors.general: Connection failed. Check the service, protocol and local runtime, then retry.
